card.name: Word starts in all-caps label text
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long word split in ALL-CAPS text, such as ABS in ABSORBED, OBS in OBSERVED, RES in RESOURCES. It appears in capitalized headings and boxed warnings.

modes.label: ABSORBED in dose tables
modes.description: ABS starting ABSORBED in the header of radiation dose tables.
modes.example: ORGAN/TISSUE MEAN<< ABS>>ORBED DOSE PER UNIT ADMINISTER

modes.label: Other capitalized warning words
modes.description: OBS, RES, UNS or PRE starting a word in uppercase warning text.
modes.example: NEUTROPENIA HAS BEEN<< OBS>>ERVED IN ASSOCIATION WITH CIDO

card.plain: It fires on the opening chunk of a long capitalized word, like ABSORBED or OBSERVED, in uppercase label headings and warnings.
